items.quote: When I heard my son would marry next year and take his wife’s last name, I did not like it.
items.meaning_ja: 私はそれを好ましく思わなかった
items.further_expression: not be a fan of something
items.further_meaning_ja: 何かをあまり好まない
items.frame_further_en: I was not a fan of it.
items.point_ja: a fan ofは有名人のファンだけでなく、物や方法などを好む場合にも使える。

items.quote: Changing my last name did not bother me at all.
items.target_span: did not bother me at all
items.meaning_ja: 改姓は私にとってまったく気にならなかった
must_preserve: 影響を受けたのが話者
items.further_meaning_ja: 少しも人の気にならない
items.frame_base_en: Changing my surname did not bother me at all.
items.frame_further_en: Changing my surname did not bother me one bit.
items.point_ja: 否定文のone bitは「少しも～ない」。notと組み合わせて、否定を強める。

items.quote: Every morning, I kindly asked about his night's sleep.
items.meaning_ja: 彼が昨夜よく眠れたか尋ねた
items.further_meaning_ja: 〜がどのように眠れたか尋ねる
items.frame_base_en: Someone asked about his sleep the night before.
items.frame_further_en: Someone asked how he had slept the night before.
items.point_ja: 間接疑問ではhowの後ろを主語＋動詞の語順にする。直接尋ねるならHow did you sleep?が使える。

items.quote: I could not stand any more.
items.target_span: I could not stand any more
items.prototype: I could not stand it any more
items.meaning_ja: もうこれ以上耐えられなかった
items.further_expression: could not put up with something any more
items.further_meaning_ja: もうこれ以上〜に耐えられなかった
items.frame_base_en: I could not stand it any more.
items.frame_further_en: I could not put up with it any more.
items.point_ja: put up withで「〜を我慢する」。対象はwithの後ろに置き、代名詞ならput up with itとする。
脈を測るときはtakeとpulseを組み合わせる。体温を測る場合もtake someone's temperatureと言う。

items.quote: They had no homework, but they were ready to explore.
items.meaning_ja: 探索する用意ができていた
must_preserve: 探索に取りかかれる状態
items.further_meaning_ja: 探索に取りかかる用意ができている
items.frame_further_en: They were all set to explore.
items.point_ja: be all set to doで「〜する用意ができている」。all setの後ろにはto不定詞を続けられる。

items.quote: A discovery that is not useful now might be a useful card to play next time, if it is saved.
items.frame_base_en: This information is not useful now.
items.frame_further_en: This information is of no use now.
items.point_ja: be of no useで「役に立たない」。useは名詞なので、no usefulとはしない。

items.quote: These two results need to be studied separately.
items.meaning_ja: 別々に検討される必要がある
must_preserve: 二つの結果を別々に検討すること
items.further_expression: need to be looked at separately
items.further_meaning_ja: 別々に検討される必要がある
items.frame_base_en: The two results need to be studied separately.
items.frame_further_en: The two results need to be looked at separately.
items.point_ja: look atは資料や結果を「検討する」という意味でも使う。受動態でもatを落とさず、be looked atとする。

items.quote: When the researchers looked at whether the AIs could build more than two, the experienced group did better.
items.meaning_ja: 比較対象よりよい成績を収めた
must_preserve: 比較対象より成績がよいという意味
items.further_meaning_ja: 比較相手よりよい成績を収める
items.frame_base_en: They did better than the other group.
items.frame_further_en: They came out ahead of the other group.
items.point_ja: 比較相手はahead ofの後ろに置く。結果や成績を比較する場面で使え、相手が明らかならof以下は省略できる。

items.quote: I still find it a little hard that I don’t get much time to myself while living at my wife’s parents’ home, but adjusting to the way each family does things was harder than changing my last name.
items.target_span: don’t get much time to myself
items.prototype: not get much time to oneself
items.meaning_ja: 自分一人で過ごせる時間があまりない
must_preserve: 自分一人で過ごす時間
items.further_meaning_ja: 一人で過ごせる時間があまりない
items.frame_base_en: They do not get much time to themselves.
items.frame_further_en: They do not get much alone time.
items.point_ja: alone timeは「一人で過ごす時間」を表す名詞のまとまり。量を表すときはmanyではなくmuchを使う。

items.quote: When they care about different things, how can they choose something they can both accept?
items.meaning_ja: それぞれが異なることを大切にしている
must_preserve: 複数の人の間で重視することが異なる
items.further_meaning_ja: それぞれ重視することが異なる
items.point_ja: 人同士で重視することの違いを述べる表現。priorityはこの意味では可算名詞で、複数ならprioritiesとする。

items.quote: He took his wife’s last name without discussing it with his parents, and I know that his mother, my aunt, was so shocked that she became ill.
items.target_span: without discussing it with his parents
items.prototype: without discussing something with one's parents
items.meaning_ja: 自分の親にそのことを相談せずに
items.further_expression: without talking something over with one's parents
items.further_meaning_ja: そのことを自分の親に相談せずに
items.frame_base_en: They decided without discussing it with their parents.
items.frame_further_en: They decided without talking it over with their parents.
items.point_ja: talk something over with someoneで「人に相談する・人と話し合う」。目的語がitならtalk it overの語順にする。
